title: Setting Boundaries with a Micromanaging Lead
npc_personality: anxious, risk-averse, highly perfectionistic, struggles to delegate, interprets independence as lack of diligence
context: Your team lead has begun requiring hourly message check-ins, rewriting code without discussion, and demanding inclusion on every internal thread. Your productivity and sense of autonomy are severely compromised. In this dedicated check-in, you must articulate the operational cost of continuous oversight, advocate for structured checkpoints, and agree on measurable accountability without making them feel that their standards are being dismissed.
opening_npc_line: Given the risk profile of this release, I need you to send me written status updates every hour today, starting now.
